scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run plan
scripts.deck:pack: mkdir -p out/presentation && rm -f out/presentation/TheSuborned-presentation.zip && ditto -c -k --keepParent presentation out/presentation/TheSuborned-presentation.zip && ls -lh out/presentation/TheSuborned-presentation.zip
scripts.deck:send: bun run deck:pack && TS="$(command -v tailscale || echo /Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale)" && "$TS" file cp out/presentation/TheSuborned-presentation.zip "${DECK_DEVICE:-skys-macbook-air-1}:" && echo "sent to ${DECK_DEVICE:-skys-macbook-air-1}"
scripts.deck:publish: rsync -a --delete --exclude README.md presentation/ out/deck-publish/ && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=9bea085fe09385497720ce4f203f8ad0 wrangler pages deploy out/deck-publish --project-name suborned-deck --branch main --commit-dirty=true
